_comment: Hand-written oracle for the <|fact:id|> grammar (§7.2). Two independent implementations must agree with it: ai/knowledge/placeholders.mjs (browser) and ai/tokenizer/spec.py (tokenizer/training). Expectations are written by hand, not generated from either implementation, so a change to one runtime cannot silently redefine the grammar the other one uses. `ids` = iterPlaceholders(text) in order, deduplicated; `whole` = isPlaceholder(text) (the text is exactly one placeholder).

cases.why: a model may still emit the surrounding spaces
a composed project-link id (§7.2's project.<id>.repo shape)
repeats are deduplicated, in first-seen order
an empty id resolves to nothing; it must never be guessed
the grammar does not police id shape — resolution against knowledge.json does
same: a space in the id is a resolution failure, not a grammar failure
whole=false when anything else is present
not anchored — the inner match is still extracted
a broken first delimiter must not swallow the second placeholder
